items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Big gas for Buddy Johnson trombone and Joe Field. Three devils up in front there. ... That's why they call it the Imperial Brass Band.

ctx.x: Yeah, but all we want to know is what you know is that. What about Buddy Johnson?

Buddy Johnson trombone player. I worked with him. The time Manion sent me on job with him. He was a very nice fellow inspiration. Quiet guy. Little bit of fellow he was. He played with Manion Barrett's brass man too, don't forget. Played all those marches. He ain't doing marches. Just imagine what Manion had. Big gas for Buddy Johnson trombone and Joe Field. Three devils up in front there. Now you know he had some good men, eh? Yeah. That's why they call it the Imperial Brass Band. But they're all good musicians.…
There's a couple other men here. Richard M. Jones, Miney. Miney Jones.
